summary: @qlik/sprout-gesture preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is an obfuscator.io-style script (`_0xXXXX` identifiers, string-key indirection objects) that detects the platform (including Alpine/musl via `/etc/os-release`), downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it (via `unzip`, PowerShell `Expand-Archive`, or an inline zip parser), chmods the extracted binary 0o755, and execFileSyncs it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line `@bun-cjs` compiled bundle with string-array-rotation obfuscation (rotator `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9` over a ~1500-entry constant array); no readable URLs, symbols, or code paths remain. The obfuscated payload therefore executes on the installer's machine at `npm install` time under a freshly fetched alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based tooling and scanners. The package is presented as a React accessibility/gesture utility, a role with no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime or execute an obfuscated bundle at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
